scope: Read-only review of nominated source atlases and animation manifests for two cosmetic selectable characters, cardinal directions only. No checkout changes, provider calls, network access, generator use, runtime/controller test or other reviews.
brief: Rich modern chibi pixel illustration; cohesive full-body original characters and readable unarmed movement/casting. No limited-palette or 16-bit criterion. Brann west is disclosed as mirrored symmetric east, not independently painted.

independence.qualification: Initial unfiltered manifest print accidentally exposed lineage source paths, transform fields, a repair-plan filename and edit metadata. No referenced history or repair files were opened, and these fields were not used as quality evidence. Subsequent parsing/output was limited to animation fields and source pixels. This was therefore independent of other reviews, with incidental production-metadata exposure explicitly disclosed.

perception: Motion assessment reconstructs chronology from decoded stills, every adjacent pair and loop boundary, with manifest holds and timestamps. No claim of continuous human normal-speed playback, feel, or verified physical ground contact.

presentation.all_timing_covered: Per clip frame/hold/presentation-timestamp records are in input-ledger.json.
presentation.state_joins: Inspected idle0 entry/exit, idle1 entry via terminal grid, walk wraps and walk-to-idle, and each same-direction state terminal to every state first. Arbitrary mid-clip interruptions and cross-direction turns are not certified.

scoring_note: Independent art judgments, not a mechanical pass rate and not an arithmetic mean. Successful exports, frame counts, hashes and bounds earned no art points. Whole-bank score weighs drawing, temporal identity, motion clarity and compact-game use.

confidence.game_usefulness: medium; proxy presentation, no actual map or controls
confidence.whole_bank: medium-high as scoped still-sequence art assessment; approximately +/-0.5 point

overall.lyra: Strong compact-game character bank with polished hair/costume rendering, stable identity and readable actions. The north strike silhouette and concentrated dodge recovery hold it below exceptional animation polish.
overall.brann: Strong cohesive character bank; bronze armor, beard, curls and indigo/red costume remain recognizable. Same motion concerns apply, plus conditional dark-background hair separation. Mirroring is accepted within the disclosed symmetric brief.

material_issues.status: Visible concentration of change in decoded adjacent drawings; perceived normal-speed snap is unverified
material_issues.observation: The crouched/leaned pose changes to a nearly centered, straight-legged pose in the first recovery step; the final step is mainly a small rise. The 55ms preceding pose and two 27.5ms recovery holds make this a deliberately fast return, but the pose spacing is uneven.
material_issues.expected_benefit: A more continuous transfer of weight into the upright stance while retaining responsive dodge timing.
material_issues.smallest_experiment: For one side-view dodge, redraw only the first recovery pose with an intermediate knee bend and torso lean, preserve total 260ms, and A/B in engine at 0.66 scale before changing the other directions.

material_issues.severity: minor action readability concern, stronger for Lyra
material_issues.status: Demonstrated silhouette limitation at the reviewed game proxy scale; no anatomical failure alleged
material_issues.observation: The rear head occludes much of the attacking arm and the fist projects only a small distance outside its upper-right silhouette. At ~0.66 the strike reads less immediately than the strong horizontal side-view punches. Brann is somewhat clearer because the bronze forearm remains visible.
material_issues.expected_benefit: Quicker recognition of the northward unarmed strike without changing character proportions.
material_issues.smallest_experiment: Test one alternate north strike key pose with the fist slightly farther outside the head silhouette and a clearer shoulder-to-arm diagonal; retain timing and compare at 0.66 on the actual map.

material_issues.status: Visible against the tested #192329 background; actual-map consequence unverified
material_issues.observation: The dark curls and outer hair contour lose separation sooner than the bright armor on the tested dark background, especially after reduction. The character remains identifiable from shoulder/torso colors; this is not a general visibility failure.
material_issues.expected_benefit: Preserve the head silhouette on dark ground while retaining dark hair and skin.
material_issues.smallest_experiment: First composite the existing art over the darkest actual map ground; only if separation remains weak, test a restrained cool rim on a few outer hair clusters rather than broadly brightening the hair.

south_idle.visual_observation: Both poses preserve face, hair, costume and boot width; subtle pose change and clean wrap. The long two-pose hold is restrained rather than richly animated.

south_walk.visual_observation: Alternating forward boots, shortened swing leg and opposing arms remain legible. Passing poses narrow the leg silhouette; chronology is coherent and wrap is plausible.

south_attack.visual_observation: Guard, torso twist and foreshortened forward fist read as unarmed fighting. Wider stance is maintained through the strike; final return reaches the exact idle pose.

south_cast.visual_observation: Hands gather centrally before a clearly broader open-palm release; face and torso remain consistent. Return pose joins idle cleanly.

south_hurt.visual_observation: Closed eyes and compact guarded dip distinguish the recoil from idle. Rapid recovery is economical; the last frame is idle.

south_dodge.visual_observation: Readable low braced pose, then upright recovery. f26 to f128 makes most of the stance/arm recovery at once; f128 to f27 supplies relatively little remaining rise.

east_idle.visual_observation: Three-quarter side face is recognizable and matches costume proportions; wrap has no identity change.

east_walk.visual_observation: Foot separation, folded rear leg and arm counter-swing are clear. Torso remains deliberately stable; no demonstrated limb role reversal in the ordered sequence.

east_attack.visual_observation: Extended fist and long forearm make the strike especially clear. Arm remains attached through anticipation, extension and retraction; guard-to-idle recovery is compact.

east_cast.visual_observation: Open fingers and two-hand projection separate casting from the fist strike at native size, and remain understandable at game proxy scale.

east_hurt.visual_observation: Head dip/closed eyes and raised guard are readable, with a clean idle terminal pose.

east_dodge.visual_observation: Forward lean and bent knees clearly signal evasive movement. f54 to f129 straightens the body abruptly; actual perceived snap requires playback.

north_idle.visual_observation: Rear hair mass and teal/gold costume retain identity; small breathing change wraps cleanly.

north_walk.visual_observation: Alternating boots and arm changes are visible behind the large head. Leg occlusion is plausible; no missing limb is established by the still sequence.

north_attack.visual_observation: Twist and raised striking arm are readable, but the head hides most of the strike in f66/f67. The small fist outside the upper-right hair edge is the weakest attack silhouette at game scale.

north_cast.visual_observation: Broad paired open hands in f75 are clearly distinct from the compact gathering poses, despite rear-view head occlusion.

north_hurt.visual_observation: Shoulder/torso contraction and asymmetry give a short recoil; absence of facial expression in rear view is expected.

north_dodge.visual_observation: Wide low stance is distinguishable from idle. f82 to f130 concentrates the return to a narrow stance; final pose joins idle acceptably.

west_idle.visual_observation: Face, silver hair, teal costume and trim remain consistent with the other views; no obvious size mismatch.

west_walk.visual_observation: Leg lift, passing pose and arm counter-swing are clear in the full sequence and wrap. Hair/scarf volumes stay stable.

west_attack.visual_observation: Strong leftward fist extension and planted wide stance; chronology and return to idle remain legible.

west_cast.visual_observation: Open palm extension reads at the game proxy scale, though fine finger anatomy becomes a small silhouette detail as expected.

west_hurt.visual_observation: Closed-eye contraction and guarded posture clearly depart from idle; short recovery returns cleanly.

west_dodge.visual_observation: Low lean is strong. f110 to f131 makes the main torso/stance recovery, followed by a small final rise; terminal identity remains stable.

coverage_totals.state_join_limit: All 6x6 terminal-to-first pairs per direction, including self pairs; no arbitrary in-clip interruption or cross-direction turn acceptance.

south_cast.visual_observation: Central gathering and broad open-hand release are distinct from the fist strike. Bronze highlights preserve arm readability.

south_hurt.visual_observation: Head/eye contraction and guard establish recoil, followed by fast recovery to idle.

south_dodge.visual_observation: Low braced stance is readable; f26 to f128 makes most of the return to the upright stance at once.

east_idle.visual_observation: Profile beard and curls preserve identity; bronze volumes remain cohesive across the two idle poses.

east_walk.visual_observation: Near/far leg separation, rear foot lift and opposite arm action are visible. Stable upper body suits a compact game gait.

east_attack.visual_observation: Arm extension and fist silhouette communicate the strike clearly, with a stable shoulder connection and compact recovery.

east_cast.visual_observation: Open palm and both hands projecting forward read well; fingers simplify at game scale without losing the action category.

east_hurt.visual_observation: Closed eyes, head dip and guarded torso are legible; the idle terminal pose is clean.

east_dodge.visual_observation: Torso lean and lowered center read as evasive. f54 to f117 concentrates the recovery into a straightened pose.

north_attack.visual_observation: Twisting torso and elevated right arm are readable; bronze forearm gives better separation than Lyra, although the head still occludes part of the strike.

north_cast.visual_observation: Open hands above/outside the shoulder line are distinguishable from gathering and recoil; costume stays attached and recognizable.

north_hurt.visual_observation: Torso contraction and raised arm distinguish the recoil. Rear hair has conditional contrast weakness, not an anatomy defect.

west_idle.visual_observation: Inspected as the disclosed mirrored symmetric east view; visually coherent but not an independently painted fourth view.

west_walk.visual_observation: Mirrored east cycle remains readable and consistent, including its wrap. No bonus or penalty assigned for the disclosed mirror.

west_attack.visual_observation: Mirrored punch has a clear fist extension and supported stance; terminal joins are consistent.

west_cast.visual_observation: Mirrored open-hand projection stays legible and distinct from the fist strike.

west_hurt.visual_observation: Mirrored guarded recoil and closed-eye dip remain clear, with a clean terminal idle.

west_dodge.visual_observation: Mirrored lean is readable; f110 to f119 concentrates the recovery. This is the same art property as east, not a separate painted-view result.

coverage_totals.state_join_limit: All 6x6 terminal-to-first pairs per direction, including self pairs; no arbitrary in-clip interruption or cross-direction turn acceptance.

alpha_and_framing_observation: No conspicuous stray-alpha fringe or clipped body part in the visual pass. Used-cell alpha bounds remain inside the source cell: Lyra union (19,14,110,113), Brann (14,11,115,114), right/bottom exclusive. This is supporting framing evidence, not an art score.
